elements.text:
You post something different from what you normally post. After a couple of hours, you only have about half the number of likes on your post compared to what you normally have. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'm confident that others will eventually like the new post.
I feel uncomfortable not knowing why I didn't receive a lot of likes, but am okay not knowing.
I feel sad that I didn't get more likes, but am able to accept that.
I feel good about my the post.
I'll never try different styles of posts again.
